source.title: ALS MED BAG or BOX INVENTORY
notes: Totals can include amounts in Bobo Bag.
Printed banner: 'ALS MED BAG or BOX INVENTORY   3/2023 Totals can include amounts in Bobo Bag.' (the rendered banner is clipped after 'Bag'; the trailing period is in the text layer).

Two-column layout. Left column: TRAUMA, IV SUPPLIES, MEDICATIONS. Right column: continuation of MEDICATIONS (RACEMIC EPI .. NORMAL SALINE 1000CCC, no header of its own), then MISCELLANEOUS, then a green RESCUE ONLY sub-section.
Only the left header cell reads 'AMOUNT MIN'; the right column has no column headers. NEED columns are blank.
Table row numbers in source_ref count the yellow title banner as row 1 and the header row (TRAUMA / RACEMIC EPI) as row 2. RACEMIC EPI sits on the same table row as the TRAUMA header.
